newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-PARMA'S BUCCI TO PERUGIA ON LOAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PARMA'S BUCCI TO PERUGIA ON LOAN.

text.p: Former Italy goalkeeper Luca Bucci, who had said he was interested in leaving Parma for an English club, joined Perugia on loan on Thursday.
Bucci joined four former Parma team mates at the serie A club, now coached by former Parma boss Nevio Scala.
The goalkeeper, capped three times by Italy and linked to Derby County, Middlesbrough and Leeds, had been on the Parma bench since November.
